title: Topological Classification of Insulators: III. Non-interacting Spectrally-Gapped Systems in All Dimensions
summary: We study non-interacting electrons in disordered materials which exhibit a spectral gap, in each of the ten Altland--Zirnbauer symmetry classes, in all space dimensions. We define an appropriate space of Hamiltonians and a topology on it so that the so-called strong topological invariants become \emph{complete} invariants yielding the Kitaev periodic table, but now derived as the set of path-connected components of the space of Hamiltonians, rather than as $K$-theory groups.
